scenario: It is 1987 and I am on a ferry from Belgium to England. Suddenly, the ferry starts tilting and water begins to pour in. I and many other passengers are trying to get to the deck by a rope ladder. I climb up the ladder and stand on the deck, looking at the 20 other passengers making their way up behind me. Directly below me, a man who is midway up the ladder seems frozen into immobility by fear or cold and is blocking the way. I try to speak and reach out to hold him, but he does not react. People behind me are jostling. The ship seems to be sinking fast and if I continue to hold on to him, he will continue blocking the ladder and the 19 other people will drown. If I release my grip on the man, he will slip off on his own and probably die from the fall, but the other people will be able to climb on deck.
choice: I decide to release my grip on the man
entities: I,19 other passengers behind the frozen man on the ladder
outcomes: The man slips off the ladder
The man is placed in mortal danger
The blockage on the ladder is cleared
The 19 passengers behind the man can continue climbing to the deck
